body.text: Flying home a few days after surgery is often the most physically tiring part of a medical trip—not the flight itself, but getting from the hotel curb to the boarding gate. [Itinerary of Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/) is an independent, client-paid, flat-fee travel and medical travel advisory run by its two founders in Türkiye—paid by our clients and independent of provider commissions. We organize your private airport transfer, mobility request timeline, and terminal support while your medical team signs off on your fitness to fly.
How far ahead (48+ hours) must you request airline wheelchair assistance (WCHR/WCHS)?

Submit your wheelchair assistance request directly through your airline at least 48 hours before departure (ideally 72 hours or more) so the Special Service Request (SSR) code—WCHR for long terminal distances or WCHS if you cannot climb stairs—is confirmed on your booking record before you arrive at IST.

According to [Turkish Airlines' Wheelchair Assistance guide](https://www.turkishairlines.com/en-kw/any-questions/special-assistance-for-passengers/wheelchair-assistance/), complimentary wheelchair service, priority check-in, and priority boarding require submitting a request at least 48 hours ahead of the flight. Their [Special Assistance overview](https://www.turkishairlines.com/en-int/any-questions/special-assistance-for-passengers/) also clarifies that passengers who can manage personal care independently in the cabin may travel without a companion while still receiving full airport mobility support.

body.text: How does IST's huge terminal distance affect post-op patients?

Istanbul Airport (IST) operates one of the world's largest single-roof terminals, where walking from international check-in through passport control to distant Pier A, B, D, or F gates can easily take 20 to 35 minutes on foot—a distance that can trigger dizziness, incision strain, or swelling spikes for post-operative patients.

Even travellers who felt fine walking around their hotel corridor on Day 6 are frequently caught off guard by IST's scale, standing times at terminal entrance security, and baggage-drop queues. The [iGA Istanbul Airport Assistance Services guide](https://www.istairport.com/en/flights/airport-guides/iga-cares-accessibility/accessibility/assistance-service?locale=en) and [iGA Cares Accessibility hub](https://www.istairport.com/en/flights/airport-guides/iga-cares-accessibility?locale=en) outline dedicated assistance call points and mobility lanes across the terminal, while non-travelling companions with mobility needs can also request complimentary landside wheelchairs at designated information desks as noted in the [IST Arrival & Age-Friendly Passenger Guide](https://www.istairport.com/en/flights/airport-guides/arrival-passenger-guide/services/passenger-services/age-friendly-airport?locale=en).
Can ITO combine wheelchair service with VIP Fast Track and curb-to-gate support?

Yes. Through our [medical tourism coordination service](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/services/medical-tourism), Itinerary of Türkiye coordinates your private hotel pickup timing with airline wheelchair handover at the departure curb and—when you want shorter queues and luggage porters—pairs it with paid [iGA Meet & Greet](https://www.igapass.com/en/iga-meet-and-greet-p-7000?locale=en) Fast Track and airside buggy transfers.

Airline wheelchair attendants provide reliable free transit from check-in to the gate, but during peak departure waves you may wait 15 to 30 minutes for an attendant. Adding Fast Track or Meet & Greet helps solo patients or companions managing multiple suitcases move smoothly through terminal entrance screening, check-in, and passport control with minimal standing.

items: Confirm your SSR code 72 hours out: Check your airline booking confirmation to verify WCHR or WCHS appears on every flight leg, including layovers.
Arrive 3 to 3.5 hours early: Allow unhurried time for curb handover, luggage drop, and mobility lane screening without rushing.
Carry your fit-to-fly letter: Keep an English doctor's fit-to-fly certificate and medication prescriptions printed in your hand luggage.
Pack zero heavy carry-ons: Check your main suitcase and keep only a small, lightweight bag with medicines, neck pillow, and documents.
Note your departure door: Ask your driver to drop you at the departure entrance closest to your airline's check-in island and assistance call point.

body.text: What happens at passport control and security with bandages or drains?

At IST security checkpoints, inform the screening officer calmly before stepping through the scanner if you have surgical dressings, splints, compression garments, or drains; officers can conduct a private pat-down or wand check upon request, and you should present your English fit-to-fly letter and prescription documentation for any syringes or liquids over 100 ml.

Bandages, nasal tape, or post-bariatric dressings do not prevent you from boarding once your licensed medical team has cleared you to travel, though airline gate staff retain final authority if a passenger appears visibly unwell or lacks written clearance after recent surgery. For passengers carrying blood-thinning injections or liquid medications, keep original pharmacy labels intact in a clear zip bag and declare them at the X-ray belt.

Want calm, curb-to-gate coordination for your departure from Istanbul? Reach out to [Itinerary of Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/) for flat-fee, independent planning covering private transfers, departure timing, and airport assistance setup. For your privacy and security, please do not send passport or ID scans, medical or financial records, or payment details in a first enquiry.

faq.q: Is airline wheelchair assistance at Istanbul Airport free?
faq.a: Yes. Standard airline wheelchair assistance (WCHR, WCHS, and WCHC) is complimentary when requested through your carrier at least 48 hours before departure. Paid add-ons apply only if you also book iGA Pass Fast Track, Meet & Greet, or private lounges.

faq.q: Can I request wheelchair assistance for a rhinoplasty or dental trip even if I can walk?
faq.a: Yes. WCHR is specifically designed for passengers who can walk short cabin distances but should not walk long airport concourses or stand in long queues after surgery or general anaesthesia.

faq.q: Will my wheelchair attendant stay with me through duty-free shopping?
faq.a: Airline wheelchair attendants focus on safe transit from check-in to the gate or designated waiting area rather than extended shopping stops. If you want lounge time or a slower pace, ask your attendant to drop you at a quiet gate seating area or pair the trip with iGA Meet & Greet.

faq.q: What if I have a connecting flight after leaving IST?
faq.a: Make sure the wheelchair SSR code (WCHR or WCHS) is added to every segment of your itinerary—not just the Istanbul departure—so an attendant meets you at the arrival jetbridge at your connection and final destination.

faq.q: Can a family member walk alongside my wheelchair at Istanbul Airport?
faq.a: Yes. One travelling companion on the same flight can typically accompany you through the designated assistance lanes at security and passport control, and help manage carry-on items.
